meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会查你报的 LazyCodex 或 Codex bug，拉取两边源码比对运行时证据，判断该由哪个仓库负责，再在对应仓库提交带复现步骤、根因和修复建议的英文 issue，并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时接管；在根因和复现路径具体到可处理之前不提交 issue。

say.text: 帮我报一个 LazyCodex 安装失败的 bug，附上复现步骤
say.note: 它会查根因并路由到对应仓库

say.text: 把这个 Codex CLI 崩溃整理成 issue 发到上游仓库
say.note: 只有上游也复现才路由到 openai/codex

say.text: 这个 bug 已经有对应 issue 了，把新证据作为评论补上
say.note: 存在匹配 issue 时改为追加评论

howto.what_en: Claude investigates the reported LazyCodex or Codex bug, pulls both source trees to compare with runtime evidence, decides which repo owns the defect, and files an English issue there with repro steps, root cause, fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug; it won't file until root cause and reproduction are concrete.

say_en.text: File a bug for my failing LazyCodex install, with repro steps
say_en.note: It finds the root cause and routes the issue

say_en.text: Turn this Codex CLI crash into an issue on the upstream repo
say_en.note: Only clean-upstream failures go to openai/codex

say_en.text: This bug already has an issue, add my new evidence as a comment
say_en.note: It comments instead of filing a duplicate
